title: tbs-Golden signals
description: Latency, traffic, errors and saturation per service, and business health. Created by scripts/observability.mjs.

panels.title: Latency p50 (ms)
panels.description: Median server-side response time per service, from the traces.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, round(approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5) / 1000.0, 1) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE span_kind = '2' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Latency p95 (ms)
panels.description: 95th percentile per service. The alert watches the Gateway above 1000 ms.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, round(approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000.0, 1) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE span_kind = '2' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, round(approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.99) / 1000.0, 1) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE span_kind = '2' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Traffic: requests per minute
panels.description: Server requests per minute per service.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE span_kind = '2' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Errors: 5xx rate (%)
panels.description: Share of 5xx responses per service. The alert fires above 5 % with at least 20 requests in 5 minutes.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, round(sum(CASE WHEN http_response_status_code >= '500' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / count(*), 2) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE span_kind = '2' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Saturation: DB pool use (%)
panels.description: Used connections / maximum pool size per Spring service.

queries.query: SELECT u.x_axis_1 AS x_axis_1, u.breakdown_1 AS breakdown_1, round(u.v * 100.0 / l.v, 1) AS y_axis_1 FROM (SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, max(value) AS v FROM db_client_connections_usage WHERE state = 'used' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1) u JOIN (SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, max(value) AS v FROM db_client_connections_max GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1) l ON u.x_axis_1 = l.x_axis_1 AND u.breakdown_1 = l.breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Saturation: JVM live heap (% of max)
panels.description: Old generation after the last GC / maximum heap, per Spring service.

queries.query: SELECT u.x_axis_1 AS x_axis_1, u.breakdown_1 AS breakdown_1, round(u.v * 100.0 / l.v, 1) AS y_axis_1 FROM (SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, max(value) AS v FROM jvm_memory_used_after_last_gc WHERE jvm_memory_pool_name = 'G1 Old Gen' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1) u JOIN (SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, max(value) AS v FROM jvm_memory_limit WHERE jvm_memory_pool_name = 'G1 Old Gen' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1) l ON u.x_axis_1 = l.x_axis_1 AND u.breakdown_1 = l.breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Saturation: CPU (%)
panels.description: JVM process CPU (Spring services) and Gateway CPU as % of one core.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, round(max(value) * 100, 1) AS y_axis_1 FROM jvm_cpu_recent_utilization GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, round(max(value) * 100, 1) AS y_axis_1 FROM process_cpu_utilization GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Saturation: Gateway event-loop delay p99 (ms) and RSS (MB)
panels.description: The idle baseline of the delay is about 20 ms.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, round(max(value), 1) AS y_axis_1 FROM nodejs_eventloop_delay_p99 GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, service_name AS breakdown_1, round(max(value) / 1048576.0, 0) AS y_axis_1 FROM process_memory_rss GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'booking-seat' AND entity = 'booking' AND action = 'CONFIRM' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'booking-seat' AND entity = 'booking' AND action = 'CANCEL' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Business: failed payment attempts
panels.description: Payment attempts that Stripe reported as failed.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'payment' AND body LIKE 'Payment attempt failed%' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Business: refund and outbox failures
panels.description: Refund failures, dead outbox jobs and e-mail send failures.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE severity = 'ERROR' AND (body LIKE 'Stripe refused refund%' OR body LIKE 'Refund % could not be sent to Stripe%' OR body LIKE '%flagged REFUND_FAILED%') GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE severity = 'ERROR' AND body LIKE 'Outbox job%giving up%' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'notification' AND (body LIKE 'Email %not sent, next try%' OR body LIKE 'Email %giving up%') GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Saturation: outbox backlog (booking-seat)
panels.description: Pending jobs and age in seconds of the oldest.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, max(value) AS y_axis_1 FROM tbs_outbox_pending GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, max(value) AS y_axis_1 FROM tbs_outbox_oldest_pending_age GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
